findings.observed_behavior: The setup-time h5py handle remained open after building the lazy dataset, and transformations in the child readers could drop the close callback.

findings.observed_behavior: tolnet_preprocess returns a transformed Dataset without the original Xarray backend close callback, so calling close() on the returned lazy Dataset did not release the DATA-group HDF5 handle.

findings.user_impact: Repeated lazy TOLNet reads could retain open HDF5 file handles after callers closed their Datasets.

findings.observed_behavior: The direct readers renamed and concatenated per-file Datasets without preserving a reliable close callback on the converted output; partial opening failures also left earlier files open.

findings.user_impact: Multi-file reads could retain open file handles after output close or fail partway through opening, affecting repeated reads and resource limits.

findings.observed_behavior: The direct NetCDF readers returned Dask DataFrames built from open_mfdataset without closing the source Dataset. Xarray transformations could also lose its close callback unless ownership was attached from the original opened Dataset.

findings.user_impact: Repeated Dask table reads could retain NetCDF file resources, and callers closing lazy Xarray outputs were not guaranteed to release the original handles.

findings.observed_behavior: The direct NetCDF branch returned Dask DataFrames without closing the source and lazy Xarray transformations did not reliably preserve source close ownership; eager loading also left the original source open.
findings.proposed_resolution: Close the source after eager materialization or Dask DataFrame graph construction and transfer the original backend close callback to lazy Xarray output.
findings.user_impact: Direct ACTRIS NetCDF reads could retain file resources after output creation or caller close.

findings.observed_behavior: The reader overwrote the explicit use_dask value with lazy or n_procs > 1, so use_dask=True and lazy=False selected the eager pandas path.
findings.proposed_resolution: Normalize use_dask=True to lazy=True before URL chunk planning and before deriving the parallel/eager selection.
findings.user_impact: Callers using the documented Dask alias received a materialized DataFrame.

findings.observed_behavior: use_dask=True reached PointReader but subclass-level wide_fmt logic still saw lazy=False and invoked the eager long-to-wide pivot.
findings.proposed_resolution: Normalize use_dask=True to lazy=True before output-shape and preparation decisions.
findings.user_impact: Users could get materialized output and a hidden pivot compute despite selecting the Dask alias.

findings.observed_behavior: NDBC post-processing checked lazy before normalizing use_dask; with use_dask=True and lazy=False, it computed the Dask DataFrame before xarray conversion.
findings.proposed_resolution: Normalize use_dask=True to lazy=True before NDBC performs post-processing.
findings.user_impact: The public Dask alias returned a materialized result after source-specific post-processing.

findings.observed_behavior: OpenAQ v2 made its own lazy branch before using a shared driver and accepted use_dask only through **kwargs; the alias did not select the Dask branch and could leak into API request kwargs.
findings.proposed_resolution: Expose use_dask explicitly and normalize it to lazy before the custom delayed-fetch branch.
findings.user_impact: Callers using the standard Dask alias could receive eager behavior or a request-layer error.

findings.observed_behavior: The custom reader accepted use_dask through **kwargs but neither forwarded it nor produced Dask-backed data; its SOAP helper parses the complete response eagerly.
findings.proposed_resolution: Make use_dask explicit and reject before remote retrieval with a source-named unsupported-option error until the endpoint supports deferred payload access.
findings.user_impact: A Dask request silently performed a full eager retrieval.

findings.observed_behavior: GEOMS HDF5 always built Dask arrays regardless of use_dask and the flag was not forwarded; HDF4 always materializes arrays in NumPy.
findings.proposed_resolution: Use NumPy for the eager HDF5 path, retain serializable file-backed Dask arrays for use_dask/lazy, and explicitly reject HDF4 Dask requests.
findings.user_impact: The Dask option did not control reader behavior, and default HDF5 reads unexpectedly remained lazy.

findings.observed_behavior: GEOMS timestamps could be a same-named auxiliary coordinate on the time dimension. Eager to_dataframe().reset_index() then raised a duplicate-time error; Dask conversion added a positional index column and returned a different column order.
findings.proposed_resolution: Promote the time variable to a coordinate, avoid resetting a duplicate eager time index, drop the synthetic Dask index, and align Dask columns to Xarray variable order.
findings.user_impact: Pandora/NDACC eager table conversion could fail, and lazy tables had a different schema from eager results.

findings.observed_behavior: RAQMS accepted use_dask but omitted it from XarrayDriver.open, so only the separate lazy keyword activated Dask.
findings.proposed_resolution: Forward the public use_dask option to each underlying XarrayDriver.open call.
findings.user_impact: Callers requesting the standard use_dask alias received eager backend behavior.

findings.observed_behavior: OMPS Nadir consumed use_dask at its group-merging layer but omitted it from each underlying driver open.
findings.proposed_resolution: Forward the public use_dask option to each underlying XarrayDriver.open call.
findings.user_impact: Callers requesting the standard use_dask alias received eager backend behavior.

findings.observed_behavior: The shared Xarray driver accepted chunks=None alongside use_dask=True or lazy=True, which silently disabled Dask-backed array reads.
findings.proposed_resolution: Reject chunks=None whenever the normalized request is Dask-backed; preserve chunks=None for explicitly eager reads.
findings.user_impact: Callers could request Dask-backed loading and receive eager arrays without an error.

findings.observed_behavior: Lazy conversion called to_dask_array(lengths=True) independently for each output column, causing repeated input scans that grew with table width. The 11-column PAMS case triggered 11 Dask computations.
findings.proposed_resolution: Compute partition lengths once, materialize the delayed partition list once, and build every output Dask array from those shared delayed partitions.
findings.user_impact: Wide point tables repeated full partition preparation once per column before returning an otherwise Dask-backed Xarray Dataset.

findings.observed_behavior: Lazy PAMS Xarray output separately parsed the first complete JSON input for Dask schema inference and again for unit metadata.
findings.proposed_resolution: Parse the first file once, pass its empty post-reader frame as explicit Dask meta, and reuse its unit mapping.
findings.user_impact: The first full input was decoded an avoidable extra time during setup.

findings.observed_behavior: Before the fix, AQS passed meta=None to from_delayed, causing Dask to parse the first complete CSV during lazy open and reread it when computed.
findings.proposed_resolution: Build post-reader metadata from the CSV header and first row, pass it explicitly to the table driver, and retain the bounded probe disclosure.
findings.user_impact: A lazy request read the entire first file before returning, which was costly for large AQS inputs.

findings.observed_behavior: The lazy CRN reader merged an object WBANNO column with a Dask string column. Dask warned that merge-key dtype mismatches can produce unexpected results.
findings.proposed_resolution: Normalize the CRN join key to the same Arrow string dtype on both Dask merge inputs while preserving eager object dtype.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_crn.py::test_crn_eager_lazy_consistency, with Dask dtype-mismatch warnings promoted to errors.
findings.user_impact: The station metadata join used inconsistent key dtypes and emitted a warning on the lazy path.

findings.observed_behavior: Dask warned that NDBC source siteid had object dtype while station metadata siteid was a Dask string dtype during the lazy metadata join.
findings.proposed_resolution: Normalize both lazy station join keys to string[pyarrow] before constructing the metadata Dask DataFrame; preserve eager behavior.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_ndbc.py::test_ndbc_eager_vs_lazy with Dask merge dtype warnings promoted to errors.
findings.user_impact: The station join used inconsistent Dask merge-key dtypes and emitted a warning about possible unexpected results.

findings.observed_behavior: The former pandas.to_datetime call on a Dask Series eagerly produced a pandas DatetimeIndex, causing unsupported Dask column assignment during lazy reader harmonization.
findings.proposed_resolution: Use dask.dataframe.to_datetime for lazy series and keep pandas conversion for eager dataframes.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_ameriflux.py::test_ameriflux_use_dask_uses_bounded_schema_probe failed at AmeriFluxReader.harmonize with a Dask assignment TypeError before the partition-local conversion fix.
findings.user_impact: use_dask=True table output failed before returning a lazy dataframe.

findings.observed_behavior: The previous duplicate full CSV parser call during Xarray layout preparation is removed; the one-file regression now observes one preparation parse after the bounded schema probe.
findings.proposed_resolution: Completed: share one partition parse across layout length and required coordinate preparation; retain the explicit one-pass preparation disclosure.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_ameriflux.py::test_ameriflux_use_dask_xarray_shares_length_preparation verifies [one-row schema probe, one full preparation pass, one full evaluation pass].
findings.user_impact: Previously unnecessary extra preparation I/O and latency are removed. One full pass remains necessary for node layout, and evaluation rereads the data.

findings.observed_behavior: The shared multi-file NetCDF driver used xarray.open_mfdataset, which returned Dask-backed data even when the caller selected the eager default and supplied no chunks.
findings.proposed_resolution: Materialize and close the implicitly lazy multi-file result only when use_dask is false and chunks were not explicitly supplied.
findings.user_impact: Default UFS multi-file reads unexpectedly returned lazy arrays and retained source backend handles.

findings.observed_behavior: Deferred table-to-Xarray conversion parsed each of four partitions four times during preparation, independent of table width.
findings.proposed_resolution: Compute each partition length and required index-key columns together, then construct Dask-backed data variables from the retained shared delayed partition graph.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_dask_reader_execution.py::test_table_and_xarray_conversion_share_preparation_without_persist (pre-fix observation: 16 parser calls for four partitions).
findings.user_impact: Wide output preparation repeated full partition parses and increased opening cost before explicit evaluation.

findings.observed_behavior: The eager reader stored its first ten physical lines in the info attribute, including several payload rows. Deferred metadata stored only the bounded schema sample, so meaningful provenance differed across evaluation modes.
findings.proposed_resolution: Limit info to the source preamble and column header; preserve the schema metadata on the Dask DataFrame and copy it onto deferred Xarray output.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_conformance.py::test_c05_dual_backend_equivalence[aeronet-table] and [aeronet-wide_dataset] failed exact attribute parity before the fix.
findings.user_impact: Eager and deferred results did not preserve identical source metadata, and eager metadata included a small amount of observation payload.

findings.observed_behavior: With expand2d=False, conversion computed partition lengths and then implicitly evaluated Dask-backed time/siteid columns when assigning them as Xarray coordinates, causing two parser passes per partition.
findings.proposed_resolution: Collect required time/siteid coordinate values together with partition lengths in one delayed task per partition and use those eager arrays as Xarray coordinates.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_scale_deferred.py::TestPointDeferred.test_long_xarray_preparation_batches_coordinate_discovery failed with eight parser calls for four partitions.
findings.user_impact: Long Xarray conversion performed duplicate full partition parsing before returning even though the observation data remained deferred.

findings.observed_behavior: Dask dataframe construction converted parser object-string columns to PyArrow string dtype, so computing a lazy table did not preserve eager pandas dtypes.
findings.proposed_resolution: Construct the Dask DataFrame in a scoped dataframe.convert-string=False configuration context, restoring the caller setting immediately after graph construction.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_ish.py::test_ish_eager_lazy_consistency failed pandas assert_frame_equal before the shared-driver fix.
findings.user_impact: Users received dtype changes when selecting lazy loading, despite identical values.

findings.observed_behavior: The shared driver injected chunks={} into the whole-file HYSPLIT parser and failed with a generic unexpected-option error instead of rejecting the unsupported Dask request at the reader boundary.
findings.proposed_resolution: Reject lazy/use_dask requests before parser invocation and state that complete-file NumPy decoding prevents Dask-backed input.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_hysplit_opt.py::test_hysplit_reader_eager_and_lazy_rejection (before fix, use_dask=True reached open_dataset_hysplit with injected chunks).
findings.user_impact: Callers could not distinguish unsupported lazy input from malformed data or driver errors.

findings.observed_behavior: Caller chunks keyed by standardized dimensions such as time were applied before CAMx preprocessing and did not match the source TSTEP dimension, leaving a single full-size chunk.
findings.proposed_resolution: Map standardized time/x/y/z chunk keys to TSTEP/COL/ROW/LAY before opening the file.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_camx.py::test_camx_eager_lazy failed its expected time chunk layout before the reader remapping.
findings.user_impact: Callers could not control CAMx read task sizes using the dimensions exposed by the returned Dataset.

findings.observed_behavior: The binary parser reads records into a complete pandas DataFrame before Dask output conversion; a chunks option cannot limit parser reads.
findings.proposed_resolution: Reject chunks explicitly and document that the parser materializes the binary input before output conversion.
findings.user_impact: Callers cannot use chunks to bound PARDUMP parser memory.

findings.observed_behavior: The binary reader fully decodes input files to NumPy arrays before returning; chunks cannot partition the input read.
findings.proposed_resolution: Reject chunks at the public reader boundary and document the whole-file parser constraint.
findings.user_impact: Callers cannot use chunks to reduce HYSPLIT parser memory or source-read sizes.

findings.observed_behavior: HYTRAJ parses an entire trajectory text file into a single pandas DataFrame partition; chunks passed to open_dataset were ignored by the reader.
findings.proposed_resolution: Reject chunks explicitly and document one file per delayed parse partition.
findings.user_impact: Callers cannot split a large trajectory text input into smaller parse tasks with chunks.

findings.observed_behavior: The reader applied chunks={"z":5} before replacing HDF5 phony dimensions with standardized z/time names, so the returned profile used a single full-height chunk.
findings.proposed_resolution: Probe dimension metadata without loading values, translate z/time chunk keys to raw dimensions, then open the lazy payload with those chunks.
findings.reproduction: tests/test_tolnet.py::test_tolnet_reader_lazy failed the expected chunk-size assertion before chunk-key translation.
findings.user_impact: Callers selecting standardized profile chunk keys could not control TOLNet partition layout.

findings.observed_behavior: The remote SOAP service returns a complete requested subset payload, so caller chunks cannot control source reads or memory.
findings.proposed_resolution: Reject chunks before the SOAP request and document that the service delivers one complete subset.
findings.user_impact: Callers cannot bound MODIS ORNL response memory with Dask chunk settings.

findings.observed_behavior: Dask DataFrame conversion named the generated observation index `index`, while eager pandas output named it `node`, causing output schema drift.
findings.proposed_resolution: Rename the generated Dask DataFrame index column to node when converting point records.
findings.user_impact: Consumers using use_dask=True received a different table schema from the eager reader.

findings.observed_behavior: The Dask table path added an unwanted integer index column and the Dask Xarray path bypassed eager point-to-UGRID reshaping, returning scalar station coordinates and a different dimension layout.
findings.proposed_resolution: Convert the Dask-backed table without resetting its index and use the same point-to-Xarray conversion as eager output while retaining Dask columns.
findings.user_impact: TCCON use_dask=True returned a table or Dataset schema that differed from the eager API.

findings.observed_behavior: Xarray 2025.12.0 silently accepted an unknown dimension in a chunks mapping, leaving the requested layout unapplied.
findings.proposed_resolution: Validate mapping keys against raw source dimensions before preprocessing for native and reference-backed Xarray opens.
findings.reproduction: ERA5Reader.open_dataset(..., use_dask=True, chunks={"not_a_dimension": 1}) did not raise before the fix.
findings.user_impact: A misspelled chunk dimension silently selected backend defaults and made caller layout assumptions unreliable.

findings.observed_behavior: GEOMS HDF5 Dask tasks reopened through FileUtility without the caller storage_options.
findings.proposed_resolution: Store a serializable copy of storage_options on the path/key proxy and pass it to FileUtility for metadata and task-local opens; close wrapped streams on all exits.
findings.reproduction: Instrument FileUtility.get_fs for a GEOMS HDF5 Dask open and observe the metadata/task reopen options.
findings.user_impact: Remote authenticated or configured filesystem reads could fail or use unintended defaults at evaluation.

findings.observed_behavior: OpenAQ URL construction called Series.floor after wrapping requested dates in pandas.Series; pandas 2.3.3 raised AttributeError before any fetch path could be returned.
findings.proposed_resolution: Normalize requested dates as a DatetimeIndex before flooring and deduplicating days.
findings.reproduction: Call build_urls with a DatetimeIndex containing one or more dates; it failed at dates_requested = pd.Series(dates).floor("D").
findings.user_impact: Date-based OpenAQ reads failed on the installed pandas version, preventing requested selective retrieval.
